headline: KEM: Natural gas supply situation is stable and heat supply companies will be ready for the heating season
summary: The natural gas supply situation in Latvia is currently stable, the Ministry of Climate and Energy said. Heat supply companies will be ready for the next heating season.
why: Natural gas supply security affects heating costs for households and the operating costs of district heating companies.
